title: AgentTracer: Tracing Indirect Prompt Injection Attack through Fine-Grained Intention-Execution Alignment
title_zh: AgentTracer：通过精细化的意图-执行对齐追踪间接提示注入攻击

paragraphs.en: Large language model (LLM) agents interact with external resources to complete complex user tasks, exposing them to indirect prompt injection (IPI), where malicious instructions redirect agents toward attacker-intended tasks. Since IPI is difficult to defend against in real-world environments, post-incident tracing is essential for locating the injection source and reconstructing the attack chain. However, existing tracing methods primarily capture explicit control-flow and data-flow dependencies, overlooking the implicit relationships among tool calls driven by the malicious instruction. These tool calls may lack explicit dependencies and be interleaved with legitimate operations, making complete attack-chain reconstruction difficult. In this paper, we present AgentTracer , an intent-aware tracing framework that treats IPI as task intent drift. AgentTracer recovers implicit decision dependencies among tool calls to construct an Intent-Driven Execution Graph that connects dispersed tool calls by task intent. It combines the user request with an operation knowledge base to construct a user intent authorization space and identify intent-drift tool calls. Starting from an anomalous tool call under audit, AgentTracer performs target-based pruning and backward tracing to reconstruct the attack chain and locate the injection source and injection point. To evaluate AgentTracer in the presence of noise from normal tasks, we combine execution logs constructed from successful IPI attacks in AgentDyn and InjecAgent with normal execution logs containing 1,800 user requests and 9,000 background tool calls without IPI. In end-to-end experiments, AgentTracer achieves 94.17% injection-point accuracy and 93.56% path precision. Comparative experiments show that AgentTracer improves injection-point accuracy over existing methods by 18–54%.
paragraphs.zh: 大型语言模型（LLM）智能体通过交互外部资源来完成复杂的用户任务，这使其面临间接提示注入（IPI）的风险，恶意指令会引导智能体执行攻击者预设的任务。 由于在真实环境中难以防御 IPI，事后追踪对于定位注入源和重构攻击链至关重要。 然而，现有的追踪方法主要捕捉显式的控制流和数据流依赖关系，而忽略了由恶意指令驱动的工具体现之间的隐式关联。 这些工具体现可能缺乏显式依赖，并与合法操作交错出现，导致难以完整重构攻击链。 在本文中，我们提出了 AgentTracer——一个具备意图感知能力的追踪框架，它将 IPI 视为任务意图的偏移。 AgentTracer 能够恢复工具体现之间的隐式决策依赖关系，构建一个以任务意图为连接纽带的“意图驱动执行图”。 该框架将用户请求与操作知识库相结合，构建用户意图授权空间，并识别出存在意图偏移的工具体现。 AgentTracer 从审计中发现的异常工具体现出发，通过目标导向的剪枝和反向追踪，重构攻击链并定位注入源与注入点。 为了评估 AgentTracer 在正常任务噪声环境下的表现，我们将 AgentDyn 和 InjecAgent 中成功 IPI 攻击生成的执行日志，与包含 1,800 条用户请求及 9,000 条无 IPI 背景工具体现的正常执行日志相结合。 在端到端实验中，AgentTracer 实现了 94.17% 的注入点识别准确率和 93.56% 的路径精确度。 对比实验表明，AgentTracer 在注入点识别准确率上比现有方法提升了 18%–54%。

paragraphs.en: Large language model (LLM) agents have now become one of the mainstream application architectures, which can perform tasks such as office work, online shopping, and software maintenance. To handle complex user tasks, existing agents often need to interact with external resources. This exposes them to a common threat known as Indirect Prompt Injection (IPI) ( Greshake et al., 2023 ; Yi et al., 2023 ; Zhan et al., 2024 ) . IPI involves embedding malicious instructions within external resources (e.g., web pages, emails) to compromise the LLM powering an agent and redirect an agent from the user task to perform the attacker-intended task.
paragraphs.zh: 大型语言模型（LLM）智能体现已成为主流应用架构之一，能够执行办公室工作、在线购物和软件维护等任务。 为了处理复杂的用户任务，现有的智能体通常需要与外部资源进行交互。 这使其面临一种常见的威胁，即间接提示注入（IPI）（Greshake 等人，2023；Yi 等人，2023；Zhan 等人，2024）。 IPI 涉及将恶意指令嵌入外部资源（例如网页、电子邮件）中，以破坏为智能体提供支持的 LLM，并将智能体从用户任务转向执行攻击者意图的任务。

paragraphs.en: In real-world environments, IPI is ubiquitous and difficult to defend against ( Greshake et al., 2023 ; Zhan et al., 2024 ; Debenedetti et al., 2024 ) . Therefore, a security tracing and attribution method for IPI is crucial. When an anomalous tool call is discovered, auditors need a tracing method to investigate the incident. Such a method enables developers or auditors to trace the entire IPI incident through vast agent execution logs, thereby guiding developers in deploying superior and more robust agent architectures and supporting auditors in responding to incidents.
paragraphs.zh: 在真实世界环境中，IPI 无处不在且难以防御（Greshake 等人，2023；Zhan 等人，2024；Debenedetti 等人，2024）。 因此，一种用于 IPI 的安全追踪和归因方法至关重要。 当发现异常工具调用时，审计人员需要一种追踪方法来调查该事件。 此类方法使开发人员或审计人员能够通过在海量智能体执行日志中追溯整个 IPI 事件，从而指导开发人员部署更优且更稳健的智能体架构，并支持审计人员应对事件。

paragraphs.en: However, existing tracing methods ( Wang et al., 2025a ; Li et al., 2026a ; Liu et al., 2025 ; Cai et al., 2026 ; Weng et al., 2026 ) for LLM agents are limited for IPI attacks. Existing work primarily captures explicit control-flow and data-flow dependencies, overlooking the tool call sequence relationship generated by the malicious instructions, which represent the attacker intent. Since an IPI instruction can influence several tool calls without explicit dependencies between them, together with legitimate and malicious operations may alternate within one execution, existing tracing methods are incompatible for IPI attacks.
paragraphs.zh: 然而，现有针对 LLM 智能体的追踪方法（Wang 等人，2025a；Li 等人，2026a；Liu 等人，2025；Cai 等人，2026；Weng 等人，2026）在应对 IPI 攻击方面存在局限性。 现有研究主要捕捉显式的控制流和数据流依赖关系，却忽略了恶意指令所生成的工具调用序列关系，而这些序列关系恰恰体现了攻击者的意图。 由于一条 IPI 指令可以在多个工具调用之间产生影响，而它们之间并无显式依赖；加之合法与恶意操作可能在一次执行中交替出现，因此现有追踪方法无法有效应对 IPI 攻击。

paragraphs.en: Our Work. In this paper, we propose AgentTracer , an intent-aware tracing framework for IPI attacks. We define task intent to represent the tool call sequence executed by the agent for the task goal (More details in Section 2.1 ). The key of AgentTracer is to treat the IPI as a form of task intent drift by the malicious instruction, which causes the corresponding tool invocation to deviate from the user intent (i.e., the tool call sequence expected by the user). Accordingly, AgentTracer compares the agent’s task intent against the user intent to identify intent-drift operations, reconstruct the attack chain, and locate the injection source and its entry point in the agent execution log (the injection point).
paragraphs.zh: 我们的工作。 在本文中，我们提出了 AgentTracer——一个用于 IPI 攻击的意图感知追踪框架。 我们将任务意图定义为智能体为实现任务目标所执行的工具调用序列（更多细节见第 2.1 节）。 AgentTracer 的关键在于将 IPI 视为恶意指令引发的任务意图偏移，这种偏移会导致相应的工具调用偏离用户意图（即用户预期的工具调用序列）。 因此，AgentTracer 会将智能体的任务意图与用户意图进行比较，以识别存在意图偏移的操作，重构攻击链，并定位注入源及其在智能体执行日志中的入口点（即注入点）。

paragraphs.en: To achieve this goal, there are three challenges that need to be solved: (i) How to construct a tracing graph that connects tool calls driven by the task intent; (ii) How to recognize tool calls that drift from the user intent; (iii) How to efficiently reconstruct the attack chain from noisy historical agent execution logs. First, legitimate and malicious operations may be interleaved in agent execution logs. This interleaving makes it difficult to connect dispersed tool calls by task intent. Second, user requests only describe high-level goals. Therefore, it is necessary to transform a natural-language request into a concrete yet flexible authorization space, which acts as the criteria for identifying intent-drift operations. Third, historical agent execution logs contain large amounts of unrelated execution data. Effective tracing must prune the tracing space while preserving the critical log scope needed to reconstruct the attack chain.

sents.en: The anomalous tool call under audit serves as the pruning anchor.
sents.zh: 正在审计的异常工具调用充当剪枝锚点。

sents.en: AgentTracer then traces the intent-drift tool-call sequence backward to reconstruct the attack chain and locate the injection source and injection point.
sents.zh: 随后，AgentTracer 反向追溯意图偏移的工具调用序列，以重构攻击链并定位注入源和注入点。

paragraphs.en: Evaluation. We evaluate AgentTracer on two representative datasets, AgentDyn ( Li et al., 2026b ) and InjecAgent ( Zhan et al., 2024 ) , covering diverse implementations of IPI attacks. In addition, to evaluate AgentTracer under noise from normal tasks, we combine the attack logs with normal execution logs containing 1,800 user requests and 9,000 background tool calls without IPI. All attack-tracing experiments are conducted on the combined execution logs.
paragraphs.zh: 评估。 我们在两个代表性数据集上对 AgentTracer 进行了评估，即 AgentDyn（Li et al., 2026b）和 InjecAgent（Zhan et al., 2024），这些数据集涵盖了多种 IPI 攻击的实现方式。 此外，为了评估 AgentTracer 在正常任务产生的噪声环境下的表现，我们将攻击日志与包含 1,800 条用户请求和 9,000 条无 IPI 的背景工具调用的正常执行日志进行了结合。 所有攻击追踪实验均在结合后的执行日志上进行。

paragraphs.en: Indirect Prompt Injection (IPI). LLM agents can perform complex tasks with external resource interaction, but this exposes them to a common threat known as Indirect Prompt Injection (IPI) ( Greshake et al., 2023 ; Yi et al., 2023 ; Zhan et al., 2024 ) . IPI occurs when an agent treats malicious instructions embedded in external resources as instructions for its own behavior. Unlike a direct user request, a malicious instruction enters the agent’s context through a lower-trust source, such as a retrieved webpage or a received email. The malicious instruction can introduce an unauthorized attacker intent while appearing relevant to the user request. The attacker intent may then drive a sequence of tool calls, which collectively forms an IPI attack chain.
paragraphs.zh: 间接提示注入（IPI）。 LLM 智能体可以通过与外部资源交互执行复杂任务，但这也使其面临一种常见的威胁，即间接提示注入（IPI）（Greshake 等人，2023；Yi 等人，2023；Zhan 等人，2024）。 当智能体将嵌入在外部资源中的恶意指令视为自身行为的指令时，就会发生间接提示注入（IPI）。 与直接的用户请求不同，恶意指令会通过可信度较低的来源进入智能体的上下文，例如检索到的网页或收到的电子邮件。 恶意指令可能在看似与用户请求相关的同时，引入未经授权的攻击者意图。 随后，这种攻击者意图可能会驱动一系列工具调用，这些调用共同构成一个 IPI 攻击链。

paragraphs.en: For example, Figure 1 shows a multi-step IPI attack. The user asks the agent to download the release from www.redscalar.com and upload it to a GitHub repository. While performing this task, the agent encounters a malicious instruction on the release page. The instruction induces the agent to register an attacker-controlled SSH key and clear its working memory. Meanwhile, the agent continues performing the user-authorized task, causing legitimate and malicious tool calls to become interleaved in the agent execution log. The following four malicious tool calls form the attack chain: git_add_ssh_key , get_received_emails , verify_github_account , and clear_working_memory . Suppose an audit is triggered by the final memory-clearing tool call. The reconstructed attack chain reveals the earlier registration of an attacker-controlled key, enabling auditors to revoke the malicious key and examine repository activity. The same evidence also helps developers identify security weaknesses and harden the agent architecture.
paragraphs.zh: 例如，图 1 展示了一次多步骤的 IPI 攻击。 用户要求智能体从 www.redscalar.com 下载发布版本，并将其上传到 GitHub 仓库。 在执行此任务时，智能体在发布页面上遇到了一条恶意指令。 该指令诱使智能体注册一个由攻击者控制的 SSH 密钥，并清除其工作内存。 与此同时，智能体继续执行用户授权的任务，导致合法和恶意的工具调用在智能体的执行日志中交错出现。 以下四个恶意工具调用构成了攻击链：git_add_ssh_key、get_received_emails、verify_github_account 和 clear_working_memory。 假设最终的内存清除工具调用触发了审计流程。 重建的攻击链揭示了此前注册了由攻击者控制的密钥，使审计人员能够撤销该恶意密钥并检查仓库活动。 同样的证据也有助于开发者识别安全弱点，并加固智能体架构。

paragraphs.en: Definition of Task Intent. A task intent is a task goal realized by a sequence of tool calls. A task intent can be either user intent, which originates from the user request, or attacker intent, which is introduced by a malicious instruction.

When an IPI attack occurs, a malicious instruction induces the agent to pursue a new task intent. As a result, the actual tool-call sequence may become E = ⟨ u 1 , a 1 , u 2 , a 2 , … , u n , a m ⟩ E=\langle u_{1},a_{1},u_{2},a_{2},\ldots,u_{n},a_{m}\rangle , where each a i a_{i} is a tool call that deviates from the user intent. paragraphs.en: Agent Attack Investigation. Agent tracing is a form of post-incident analysis that begins when an anomalous tool call is discovered. We refer to this anomalous tool call as anomalous event . Given the anomalous event and historical agent execution logs, an auditor seeks to identify the source of the anomalous behavior and reconstruct the relevant tool-call sequence.

sents.en: Agent Attack Investigation.

sents.en: Agent tracing is a form of post-incident analysis that begins when an anomalous tool call is discovered.

sents.en: We refer to this anomalous tool call as anomalous event .

paragraphs.en: Existing tracing methods follow three main strategies: (i) tracing execution dependencies in a graph; (ii) localizing high-contribution input fragments; and (iii) estimating causal influence through counterfactual interventions. Graph-based methods represent control flow, data flow, or other explicit execution dependencies as edges in a tracing graph. They traverse the graph backward from the anomalous event to identify related operations and possible sources ( Wang et al., 2025a ; Li et al., 2026a ; Liu et al., 2025 ) . Attribution-based methods estimate the contribution of each token, text fragment, or input region to the occurrence of the anomalous event. Fragments with high contribution scores are treated as likely sources of the anomalous event ( Jia et al., 2025 ; Wang et al., 2025b ) . Counterfactual-based methods remove or replace candidate context and observe whether the anomalous event still occurs. A candidate context is considered influential if removing or replacing it prevents the anomalous event ( Cai et al., 2026 ; Weng et al., 2026 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 现有的追踪方法遵循三种主要策略：(i) 在图中追踪执行依赖关系；(ii) 定位贡献度高的输入片段；以及 (iii) 通过反事实干预估算因果影响。 基于图的方法将控制流、数据流或其他显式执行依赖关系表示为追踪图中的边。 它们从异常事件开始反向遍历图，以识别相关操作和可能的来源（Wang et al., 2025a；Li et al., 2026a；Liu et al., 2025）。 基于归因的方法估算每个词元、文本片段或输入区域对异常事件发生所做出的贡献。 贡献度得分高的片段被视为异常事件的潜在来源（Jia et al., 2025；Wang et al., 2025b）。 基于反事实的方法会移除或替换候选上下文，并观察异常事件是否仍然发生。 如果移除或替换某个候选上下文能够阻止异常事件的发生，则认为该上下文具有影响（Cai et al., 2026；Weng et al., 2026）。

paragraphs.en: Limitations of Existing Work. Existing log tracing approaches mainly infer tracing relationships from data dependencies or causal correlations, overlooking the attacker intent behind a sequence of tool calls without data dependencies and causal correlations. The case in Figure 1 illustrates the limitations of these methods in recovering IPI attacks. (i) Graph-based methods rely on explicit execution dependencies to reconstruct an attack chain, but tool calls driven by the task intent may not exchange data or expose shared parameters. In this case, parameterless attack operations such as get_received_emails and clear_working_memory cannot be connected to the other attack steps by methods relying on parameter dependencies, resulting in an incomplete attack chain. (ii) Attribution-based methods associate input fragments with the anomalous event using contribution scores. They may associate the RedScalar webpage with the final memory-clearing tool call, but cannot establish relationships among the remaining attack operations to recover an ordered attack chain. (iii) Counterfactual-based methods treat context as influential when removing or replacing it changes the anomalous event. However, legitimate repository operations and intermediate results may also affect the anomalous event and therefore be reported as possible injection sources, producing noisy source candidates and making it difficult to isolate the injection source from other causal candidates. Overall, these methods do not trace how attacker intent is realized through a sequence of tool calls, limiting their ability to recover a complete and precise IPI attack chain.

paragraphs.en: Research Goal and Scope. Motivated by the limitations of prior approaches, we propose AgentTracer , an intent-aware tracing framework for investigating IPI attacks. Given historical agent execution logs and a anomalous event (e.g., the credentials.json file is deleted), AgentTracer determines whether the anomalous event is attributable to IPI and, if so, identifies the injection source (e.g., a webpage containing the malicious instruction), locates the injection point (e.g., the tool call that retrieves the webpage), and reconstructs the complete attack chain. The recovered attack chain contains the ordered malicious tool calls while excluding interleaved legitimate tool calls. This evidence enables auditors to assess the impact of the attack and respond appropriately, while helping developers identify security weaknesses exposed by the incident.
paragraphs.zh: 研究目标与范围。 鉴于先前方法的局限性，我们提出了 AgentTracer——一个具备意图感知能力的追踪框架，用于调查 IPI 攻击。 给定历史智能体执行日志和异常事件（例如 credentials.json 文件被删除），AgentTracer 可判断该异常事件是否由 IPI 引起；若是，则识别注入源（例如包含恶意指令的网页）、定位注入点（例如获取该网页的工具调用），并重构完整的攻击链。 恢复的攻击链包含按顺序排列的恶意工具调用，同时排除了穿插其中的合法工具调用。 这些证据使审计人员能够评估攻击的影响并采取适当响应，同时帮助开发者识别事件暴露的安全弱点。

paragraphs.en: AgentTracer applies to agents whose execution logs contain user requests, reasoning records, and tool records (including tool calls and tool results). We consider attackers who can embed natural-language instructions in external resources processed by the agent but cannot modify the original user request or the agent execution logs. Our analysis focuses on IPI attacks in which malicious instructions affect agent reasoning and lead to observable tool calls. Attacks that do not result in tool execution are outside the scope of AgentTracer .
paragraphs.zh: AgentTracer 适用于执行日志中包含用户请求、推理记录以及工具记录（包括工具调用和工具结果）的智能体。 我们考虑的攻击者能够将自然语言指令嵌入智能体处理的外部资源中，但无法修改原始用户请求或智能体的执行日志。 我们的分析重点关注 IPI 攻击，即恶意指令影响智能体的推理过程，并导致可观察到的工具调用。 未导致工具执行的攻击不在 AgentTracer 的覆盖范围内。

paragraphs.en: To achieve the research goal in this paper, there are three challenges that need to be solved:
paragraphs.zh: 为实现本文的研究目标，需要解决以下三个挑战：

paragraphs.en: C1: How to construct a tracing graph that connects tool calls by task intent.
paragraphs.zh: C1：如何构建一个根据任务意图连接工具调用的追踪图。

paragraphs.en: During an execution, an agent may work on multiple tasks. Each task intent can drive a sequence of tool calls, and tool calls from different sequences may be interleaved. Consequently, in an IPI attack, legitimate and malicious tool calls may appear interleaved in the agent execution log. Moreover, these malicious tool calls may not share explicit dependencies. It is therefore difficult to connect dispersed tool calls by task intent.
paragraphs.zh: 在执行过程中，一个智能体可能同时处理多个任务。 每个任务意图都可以触发一系列工具调用，并且来自不同序列的工具调用可能会交错出现。 因此，在 IPI 攻击中，合法和恶意的工具调用可能会交错出现在智能体的执行日志中。 此外，这些恶意工具调用可能没有显式的依赖关系。 因此，很难根据任务意图将分散的工具调用关联起来。

sents.en: During an execution, an agent may work on multiple tasks.
sents.zh: 在执行过程中，一个智能体可能同时处理多个任务。

sents.en: Each task intent can drive a sequence of tool calls, and tool calls from different sequences may be interleaved.
sents.zh: 每个任务意图都可以触发一系列工具调用，并且来自不同序列的工具调用可能会交错出现。

sents.en: Consequently, in an IPI attack, legitimate and malicious tool calls may appear interleaved in the agent execution log.
sents.zh: 因此，在 IPI 攻击中，合法和恶意的工具调用可能会交错出现在智能体的执行日志中。

sents.en: Moreover, these malicious tool calls may not share explicit dependencies.
sents.zh: 此外，这些恶意工具调用可能没有显式的依赖关系。

sents.en: It is therefore difficult to connect dispersed tool calls by task intent.
sents.zh: 因此，很难根据任务意图将分散的工具调用关联起来。

paragraphs.en: Solution: Decision-dependency recovery. Tool calls that collectively realize one task intent exhibit decision dependencies. The result of one tool call changes the agent’s context and informs the decision to invoke a later tool, allowing task execution to continue until the task goal is achieved. These dependencies provide a basis for connecting dispersed tool calls by task intent.
paragraphs.zh: 解决方案：决策依赖恢复。 共同实现单一任务意图的工具调用之间存在决策依赖关系。 一次工具调用的结果会改变智能体的上下文，并为后续调用其他工具提供决策依据，从而让任务执行得以持续进行，直到达成任务目标。 这些依赖关系为根据任务意图连接分散的工具调用提供了基础。

sents.en: Solution: Decision-dependency recovery.
sents.zh: 解决方案：决策依赖恢复。

paragraphs.en: C2: How to recognize tool calls that drift from the user intent.
paragraphs.zh: C2：如何识别偏离用户意图的工具调用。

paragraphs.en: A tracing graph can connect dispersed tool calls by task intent, but the graph does not reveal which path drifts from the user intent. Identifying the intent-drift path requires a clear user intent authorization space for intent alignment. Constructing such a space is challenging because it must balance legitimate execution flexibility with the user’s authorization boundaries.
paragraphs.zh: 追踪图可以通过任务意图连接分散的工具调用，但该图并未揭示哪条路径偏离了用户意图。 要识别意图漂移的路径，需要一个明确的用户意图授权空间来实现意图对齐。 构建这样一个空间具有挑战性，因为它必须在合法的执行灵活性与用户的授权边界之间取得平衡。

sents.zh: 构建这样一个空间具有挑战性，因为它必须在合法的执行灵活性与用户的授权边界之间取得平衡。

paragraphs.en: Solution: Knowledge-enhanced intent alignment. The user request usually describes only a high-level goal, while legitimate execution may require supporting operations that are not explicitly stated. AgentTracer introduces an operation knowledge base to supply this missing information and combines it with the user request to construct a structured authorization space for intent alignment.
paragraphs.zh: 解决方案：基于知识的意图对齐。 用户请求通常仅描述一个高层次目标，而合法执行可能需要一些未明确说明的辅助操作。 AgentTracer 引入一个操作知识库来补充这些缺失信息，并将其与用户请求结合，以构建用于意图对齐的结构化授权空间。

paragraphs.en: User Intent Alignment. Taking the user request, operation knowledge, and the intent-driven execution graph as input, this module combines the user request with operation knowledge to instantiate a structured user intent authorization space. Considering that IPI-induced behavior typically invokes an unauthorized operation, changes the target of an authorized operation, or violates an execution constraint. The module evaluates the agent’s behavior along the action, target, and constraint dimensions. The module outputs the graph with intent-drift edges marked.

paragraphs.en: This module reconstructs the tool-call sequence that represents each task intent. The module takes a LogSegment as input and outputs an Intent-Driven Execution Graph ( IntentExecGraph ). An agent often completes a task through a series of dependent tool calls: the result of one call enters the agent’s context and informs a later tool decision. Accordingly, AgentTracer extracts resource nodes and contextual decision relations from the LogSegment , and grounds the relations in successful tool calls to form decision-grounded execution edges.
paragraphs.zh: 该模块重构了代表每个任务意图的工具调用序列。 该模块以 LogSegment 为输入，输出一个意图驱动的执行图（IntentExecGraph）。 智能体通常通过一系列依赖关系紧密的工具调用来完成任务：一次调用的结果会进入智能体的上下文，并影响后续的工具调用决策。 因此，AgentTracer 会从 LogSegment 中提取资源节点和上下文相关的决策关系，并将这些关系与成功执行的工具调用关联起来，从而构建出基于决策的执行边。

paragraphs.en: Graph Elements Extraction. AgentTracer first adds the user request in the LogSegment as the entry node. For each successful tool record, AgentTracer extracts the executed operation and the data objects introduced by the operation. Each extracted object becomes a resource node in N R N_{R} , while the executed operation and tool record are retained for subsequent relation grounding. To support traceback, AgentTracer also labels resource nodes according to their origins. A resource node is labeled ExternalResource if it represents content retrieved from the external environment and introduced into the agent’s context through a tool result.

paragraphs.en: Decision Dependency Extraction. Reasoning records provide the decision dependencies needed to connect tool calls by task intent. For each reasoning record, AgentTracer extracts contextual decision relations ( ContextDecisionRel ). Each ContextDecisionRel represents one tool-call decision, including the source entities supporting the decision, the intended operation, and the target entities expected from the corresponding execution. We represent a ContextDecisionRel as r = ⟨ S , A , T ⟩ r=\langle S,A,T\rangle , where S S is the set of source entities supporting the decision, A A is the intended operation, and T T is the set of expected target entities. If a reasoning record contains n n distinct tool-call decisions, the extractor produces n n ContextDecisionRel instances.

paragraphs.en: Decision Dependency Grounding. AgentTracer maps each extracted ContextDecisionRel to a set of decision-grounded execution edges between resource nodes, as illustrated in Figure 3 . For each ContextDecisionRel , AgentTracer first matches the intended operation to a successful tool call extracted from the LogSegment . AgentTracer then maps each source entity to an existing resource node and each target entity to the resource node introduced by the matched tool call. After grounding, each source–target node pair produces a directed decision-grounded execution edge that stores the executed operation as an edge attribute. When a target node of one edge serves as the source node of a later edge, the two executed tool calls become connected through their extracted decision dependency. The resulting resource nodes and decision-grounded execution edges form the IntentExecGraph . The next module performs user intent alignment to identify intent-drift edges in the graph.
paragraphs.zh: 决策依赖基础化。 AgentTracer 将每个提取出的 ContextDecisionRel 映射到资源节点之间的一组基于决策的执行边，如圖 3 所示。 对于每个 ContextDecisionRel，AgentTracer 首先将预期操作与从 LogSegment 中提取的成功工具调用进行匹配。 接着，AgentTracer 将每个源实体映射到一个现有资源节点，并将每个目标实体映射到由匹配的工具调用引入的资源节点。 基础化之后，每对源-目标节点会生成一条有向的基于决策的执行边，该边将执行的操作作为边属性存储。 当一条边的目标节点成为后续某条边的源节点时，这两个执行过的工具调用会通过它们提取出的决策依赖连接起来。 最终形成的资源节点和基于决策的执行边共同构成了 IntentExecGraph。 下一个模块会执行用户意图对齐，以识别图中的意图偏移边。

paragraphs.en: AgentTracer first constructs a structured UA-Scope from the user request as the criteria for intent alignment, because the user request provides the most direct expression of the user intent. However, the user request usually specifies high-level goals but lacks details in natural language, which makes intent alignment hard in practice. For example, the user may ask the agent to “send the quarterly report to auditor@example.com ” without specifying the execution details. The request may omit necessary preparation, such as locating and reading the report, as well as implicit authorization boundaries on the recipient and payload. To address this challenge, we build an operation knowledge base to map a user’s vague goal to a clearer, more detailed user authorization specification. AgentTracer combines the user request with an operation knowledge base to produce a concrete and structured authorization space.
paragraphs.zh: AgentTracer 首先根据用户请求构建一个结构化的 UA-Scope，作为意图对齐的标准，因为用户请求最直接地表达了用户的意图。 然而，用户请求通常只说明高层次的目标，但在自然语言中缺乏细节，这使得意图对齐在实践中变得困难。 例如，用户可能要求智能体“将季度报告发送至 auditor@example.com”，但未具体说明执行细节。 该请求可能省略了必要的准备工作，例如查找和阅读报告，以及收件人和负载相关的隐含授权边界。 为了解决这一挑战，我们构建了一个操作知识库，用于将用户模糊的目标映射到更清晰、更详细的用户授权规范中。 AgentTracer 将用户请求与操作知识库相结合，生成一个具体且结构化的授权空间。

paragraphs.en: UA-Scope Representation. The UA-Scope represents user authorization through two complementary elements: a task-frame structure and a high-level operation abstraction.

paragraphs.en: Task-frame Structure. The UA-Scope consists of task frames and the dependencies among them. Each task frame captures a distinct step in fulfilling the user goal and records the authorization information required to evaluate related tool calls, such as the principal operation and authorized target. The dependencies describe the execution relationships among these steps.
paragraphs.zh: 任务框架结构。 UA-Scope 由任务框架以及它们之间的依赖关系组成。 每个任务框架都捕捉了实现用户目标的某个独立步骤，并记录了评估相关工具调用所需的信息授权，例如主要操作和授权目标。 这些依赖关系描述了这些步骤之间的执行关系。

paragraphs.en: High-level Operation Abstraction. High-level operation classes represent the user task and agent behavior in a common semantic space. Drawing on established data-action taxonomies and capability abstractions for tool-using agents ( National Institute of Standards and Technology, 2020 ; Lin et al., 2026 ) , AgentTracer groups agent actions into four categories according to their primary effects: information acquisition, information processing, system modification, and external interaction. Based on these categories, AgentTracer defines the 11 operation classes shown in Table 1 . AgentTracer maps each task frame and tool call to the class that best describes its primary effect.

paragraphs.en: Operation Knowledge Base. The task-frame structure and high-level operation abstraction establish the basic representation of the UA-Scope but do not fully specify the authorization information required for intent alignment. The operation knowledge base fills this gap by mapping high-level user goals to detailed authorization specifications.
paragraphs.zh: 操作知识库。 任务框架结构和高层操作抽象确立了 UA-Scope 的基本表示，但并未完全明确意图对齐所需的授权信息。 操作知识库通过将高层用户目标映射到详细的授权规范来填补这一空白。

sents.en: Operation Knowledge Base.
sents.zh: 操作知识库。

sents.en: The task-frame structure and high-level operation abstraction establish the basic representation of the UA-Scope but do not fully specify the authorization information required for intent alignment.
sents.zh: 任务框架结构和高层操作抽象确立了 UA-Scope 的基本表示，但并未完全明确意图对齐所需的授权信息。

sents.en: The operation knowledge base fills this gap by mapping high-level user goals to detailed authorization specifications.
sents.zh: 操作知识库通过将高层用户目标映射到详细的授权规范来填补这一空白。

paragraphs.en: We construct the knowledge base separately for each high-level operation class. First, we examine the descriptions, required inputs, and execution effects of the tools mapped to the operation class. The execution effects determine the operation boundary, while the required inputs identify the information needed for execution ( Fikes and Nilsson, 1971 ) . Second, we use the required inputs to identify operation prerequisites and common missing-information and failure conditions to identify applicable operation follow-ups ( Russell et al., 2006 ) . Each prerequisite or follow-up rule records the condition under which it is applicable. Third, we apply least-privilege and agent-tool authorization principles to determine the operation targets and their authorized scope. We then translate these authorization requirements into operation-specific checkpoints ( Saltzer and Schroeder, 1975 ; Shi et al., 2025 ; Wang et al., 2026 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 我们为每个高级操作类单独构建知识库。 首先，我们检查与操作类映射的工具的描述、所需输入和执行效果。 执行效果决定了操作的边界，而所需输入则确定了执行所需的信息（Fikes and Nilsson, 1971）。 其次，我们利用所需输入来识别操作的前置条件以及常见的信息缺失和失败情况，从而确定适用的后续操作（Russell et al., 2006）。 每条前置条件或后续规则都记录了其适用条件。 第三，我们应用最小权限和智能体-工具授权原则，来确定操作目标及其授权范围。 接着，我们将这些授权要求转化为特定于操作的检查点（Saltzer and Schroeder, 1975；Shi et al., 2025；Wang et al., 2026）。

paragraphs.en: This procedure produces five types of operation knowledge. Operation prerequisites and failure-triggered follow-ups are recorded separately because they apply under different execution conditions. Operation targets and operation checkpoints are also recorded separately because the former specifies what must remain within the authorized scope, while the latter specifies what must be checked during execution.
paragraphs.zh: 该流程会产生五类操作知识。 操作前提条件和故障触发的后续步骤会分别记录，因为它们适用于不同的执行条件。 操作目标和操作检查点也会分别记录，因为前者规定了必须保持在授权范围内的内容，而后者则规定了执行过程中必须检查的内容。

paragraphs.en: Operation Boundary defines the concrete tool effects covered by an operation class. For example, send_resource covers tool calls that transfer information, requests, or assets across an external boundary, such as send_email , submit_form , and transfer_fund .
paragraphs.zh: 操作边界定义了某个操作类所涵盖的具体工具效果。 例如，send_resource 涵盖了在外部边界之间传输信息、请求或资产的工具调用，如 send_email、submit_form 和 transfer_fund。

paragraphs.zh: 操作前提条件指定了可能合法地先于主操作执行的支持性操作。 例如，发送文件可能需要先找到并读取该文件。

paragraphs.en: The knowledge base provides reusable authorization templates for the high-level operation classes. During UA-Scope instantiation, AgentTracer retrieves the operation knowledge associated with each mapped operation class and combines it with the user request to determine the concrete content of the corresponding task-frame fields. Together, these knowledge types enable AgentTracer to construct an authorization space that includes legitimate supporting operations without extending the authorized scope of the user task.

paragraphs.en: UA-Scope Instantiation. The UA-Scope is constructed through two-stage instantiation. In the first stage, AgentTracer extracts explicit task steps from the user request and maps each task step to a high-level operation class. AgentTracer constructs a task frame for each task step and identifies task information that must be resolved during execution. In the second stage, AgentTracer retrieves the operation knowledge associated with the mapped classes and enriches each task frame with permitted supporting operations and explicit authorization constraints. AgentTracer also identifies the execution dependencies among the task frames. The completed task frames and their dependencies form the initial UA-Scope .
paragraphs.zh: UA-Scope 实例化。 UA-Scope 通过两阶段实例化构建而成。 在第一阶段，AgentTracer 从用户请求中提取明确的任务步骤，并将每个任务步骤映射到高层操作类。 AgentTracer 为每个任务步骤构建一个任务框架，并识别执行过程中必须解决的任务信息。 在第二阶段，AgentTracer 获取与已映射类别相关的操作知识，并为每个任务框架补充允许的支持性操作和明确的授权约束。 AgentTracer 还识别任务框架之间的执行依赖关系。 完成后的任务框架及其依赖关系构成了初始的 UA-Scope。

paragraphs.en: For example, Figure 4 illustrates the UA-Scope for the request: “If the total payroll amount recorded in payroll.xlsx exceeds USD 1 million, summarize the file and send only the summary to external-auditor@example.com .” The request contains two principal task steps. paragraphs.en: UA-Scope Dynamic Completion. AgentTracer performs bounded dynamic completion when the user request explicitly authorizes a contextual entity to provide task information missing from the initial UA-Scope . In such cases, AgentTracer extracts only the parameters or task steps that the entity is authorized to provide. For example, in “pay the bill in bill.txt ,” the file may provide only the payee and amount; in “configure the system according to standard.txt ,” the manual may specify the steps required to complete the task. The authorization does not extend to other entities referenced by the authorized entity. If standard.txt instructs the agent to read data.xlsx , the spreadsheet is authorized only as a data input and cannot define new task steps. Bounded dynamic completion therefore resolves missing task information without expanding the authority granted by the user.

paragraphs.en: A ContextDecisionRel is labeled Aligned if it aligns with at least one candidate task frame. Otherwise, the ContextDecisionRel is labeled Misaligned . paragraphs.en: This module performs event-guided pruning around the anomalous event and traces intent-drift edges backward to reconstruct the attack chain. paragraphs.en: Analysis-scope Pruning. The first level narrows the analysis scope from the complete historical agent execution logs to LogSegment associated with the anomalous event. AgentTracer extracts the operation, operation target, and relevant arguments from the anomalous event. AgentTracer then searches the historical agent execution logs for tool records that match the operation and the operation target by the anomalous event. When available, arguments from the anomalous event further distinguish among multiple matching tool records. Each matching tool record is treated as a candidate occurrence, and AgentTracer extracts the corresponding LogSegment for subsequent analysis.

Otherwise, AgentTracer proceeds to the LogSegment associated with the next earlier candidate occurrence. This strategy avoids constructing graphs for historical requests unrelated to the anomalous event.

paragraphs.en: Graph-scope Pruning. After selecting a candidate LogSegment , the second level excludes failed tool calls and their associated reasoning records from graph construction. Only successful tool calls with observable results participate in the graph. A failed tool call cannot represent an executed attack step. AgentTracer also filters the reasoning record associated with the failed tool call, preventing an unexecuted tool decision from forming execution edges in the graph. If the agent replans after the failure and subsequently completes the operation, AgentTracer retains the contextual decision relation associated with the successful execution and grounds the relation in the corresponding tool call to form execution edges.

paragraphs.en: Path-scope Pruning. After constructing and aligning the IntentExecGraph , the final level limits the paths examined during traceback. AgentTracer identifies the resource node introduced by the anomalous event as the sink node, such as a deleted file or modified account record. The sink node serves as the starting point for traceback. Starting from the sink node, AgentTracer selects the incoming Misaligned edge corresponding to the anomalous event and follows Misaligned edges backward until no earlier intent-drift edge can be found. The traversed edges form the intent-drift path. Restricting traceback to this path excludes graph branches unrelated to the anomalous event. The intent-drift path determines whether the candidate occurrence is attributable to IPI:

sents.en: AgentTracer identifies the resource node introduced by the anomalous event as the sink node, such as a deleted file or modified account record.
sents.zh: AgentTracer 将异常事件引入的资源节点识别为汇点节点，例如被删除的文件或被修改的账户记录。

sents.en: The sink node serves as the starting point for traceback.
sents.zh: 汇点节点作为回溯的起点。

sents.en: Starting from the sink node, AgentTracer selects the incoming Misaligned edge corresponding to the anomalous event and follows Misaligned edges backward until no earlier intent-drift edge can be found.
sents.zh: 从汇点节点开始，AgentTracer 会选择与异常事件对应的入向 Misaligned 边，并沿着 Misaligned 边向后追溯，直到无法再找到更早的 intent-drift 边。

sents.en: The traversed edges form the intent-drift path.
sents.zh: 遍历过的边共同构成意图漂移路径。

sents.en: Restricting traceback to this path excludes graph branches unrelated to the anomalous event.
sents.zh: 将回溯限制在此路径上，可以排除与异常事件无关的图分支。

sents.en: The intent-drift path determines whether the candidate occurrence is attributable to IPI:
sents.zh: 意图漂移路径决定了候选事件是否可归因于 IPI：

paragraphs.en: If the sink node has no incoming Misaligned edge for the anomalous event, AgentTracer does not classify the candidate occurrence as IPI.
paragraphs.zh: 如果汇合节点对于该异常事件没有入向的“未对齐”边，AgentTracer 就不会将候选事件分类为 IPI。

paragraphs.en: If the root node of the intent-drift path is labeled ExternalResource , AgentTracer classifies the candidate occurrence as IPI. The root node is reported as the injection source, and the log line through which the external resource entered the agent’s context is reported as the injection point. The tool calls represented by the intent-drift path, ordered from the root node to the sink node, form the attack chain.
paragraphs.zh: 如果意图漂移路径的根节点被标记为 ExternalResource，AgentTracer 会将候选出现实例分类为 IPI。 根节点会被报告为注入源，而外部资源进入智能体上下文的日志行则会被报告为注入点。 由意图漂移路径表示的工具调用，从根节点到汇合节点按顺序排列，构成了攻击链。

paragraphs.en: Evaluation Data. To evaluate AgentTracer across different IPI scenarios, we construct two datasets of agent execution logs by executing attack cases from AgentDyn ( Li et al., 2026b ) and InjecAgent ( Zhan et al., 2024 ) . We retain only logs generated by successful IPI attacks and refer to the two resulting datasets as AgentDyn and InjecAgent. These logs support event-guided tracing evaluation because each contains an observable anomalous event, an injection point, and the corresponding attack chain.
paragraphs.zh: 评估数据。 为了在不同 IPI 场景下评估 AgentTracer，我们通过执行来自 AgentDyn（Li et al., 2026b）和 InjecAgent（Zhan et al., 2024）的攻击案例，构建了两套智能体执行日志数据集。 我们仅保留由成功的 IPI 攻击生成的日志，并将由此产生的两个数据集分别称为 AgentDyn 和 InjecAgent。 这些日志支持事件引导的追踪评估，因为每份日志都包含一个可观测的异常事件、一个注入点以及相应的攻击链。

paragraphs.en: For the ground truth in our dataset, we manually annotate each agent execution log with (i) the anomalous event, (ii) the injection point, i.e., the log line at which malicious content first enters the agent’s context, and (iii) the set K ∗ K^{*} of annotated malicious tool calls in the attack chain.

paragraphs.en: Data Augmentation. In practice, real-world agents generate large volumes of normal execution logs, including normal user requests and tool calls that do not involve IPI. To approximate this setting and evaluate AgentTracer in the presence of noise from normal tasks, we combine the attack logs with normal execution logs. Specifically, we construct a historical-log pool from agent execution logs generated over five months in a Codex environment. The pool contains 1,800 normal user requests and 9,000 background tool calls without IPI. The InjecAgent execution logs were reproduced in this Codex environment and can therefore be directly integrated into the pool. In contrast, the AgentDyn execution logs were generated in its native benchmark environment and are normalized before being inserted into the pool. In our evaluation, AgentTracer traces each IPI attack chain within the complete historical-log pool.
paragraphs.zh: 数据增强。 在实践中，真实世界的智能体会生成大量正常执行日志，包括不涉及 IPI 的正常用户请求和工具调用。 为了模拟这种场景，并在存在正常任务噪声的情况下评估 AgentTracer，我们将攻击日志与正常执行日志相结合。 具体来说，我们从 Codex 环境中五个月内生成的智能体执行日志中构建了一个历史日志池。 该日志池包含 1,800 条正常用户请求和 9,000 条不含 IPI 的背景工具调用。 InjecAgent 的执行日志是在此 Codex 环境中重新生成的，因此可以直接整合到该日志池中。 相比之下，AgentDyn 的执行日志是在其原生基准环境中生成的，在插入日志池之前会进行标准化处理。 在我们的评估中，AgentTracer 会在完整的歷史日志池内追踪每一条 IPI 攻击链。

paragraphs.en: Result Analysis. As shown in Table 2 , AgentTracer achieves an average IPI detection rate of 97.34% and an average injection-point accuracy of 94.17% across the two datasets. For attack-chain reconstruction, AgentTracer achieves an average path coverage of 90.25% and an average path precision of 93.56%. paragraphs.en: Reasons for tracing errors. The tracing errors mainly arise from two factors. First, IntentExecGraph construction depends on extracting contextual decision relations from natural-language reasoning records. The LLM may extract incorrect source entities, target entities, or intended operations. Different aliases for the entity may also cause a correctly extracted relation to be grounded in the wrong entity node. Second, an agent may deviate from the user request even without IPI. Such genuine execution deviations are correctly labeled Misaligned , but may form additional intent-drift branches unrelated to the IPI attack chain. To reduce interference from these branches, AgentTracer uses the anomalous event as the traceback anchor to exclude unrelated branches.
paragraphs.zh: 追踪错误的原因。 追踪错误主要由两个因素引起。 首先，IntentExecGraph 的构建依赖于从自然语言推理记录中提取上下文决策关系。 LLM 可能会提取错误的源实体、目标实体或预期操作。 实体的不同别名也可能导致正确提取的关系被错误地关联到错误的实体节点上。 其次，即使没有 IPI，智能体也可能偏离用户请求。 这类真实的执行偏差会被正确标记为“不一致”，但可能会形成与 IPI 攻击链无关的额外意图漂移分支。 为了减少这些分支的干扰，AgentTracer 使用异常事件作为回溯锚点，以排除无关的分支。

paragraphs.en: Replacing the IntentExecGraph with a temporal graph reduces injection-point accuracy by 17.00% and path coverage by 31.78%. paragraphs.en: This experiment evaluates whether user intent alignment incorrectly flags legitimate agent behavior. We select 100 additional injection-free agent execution logs from AgentDyn. For each agent execution log, we construct the IntentExecGraph and apply user intent alignment to every evaluable grounded ContextDecisionRel . We do not perform attack-chain traceback because these logs contain no IPI-induced anomalous event, injection point, or annotated attack chain. We measure the proportion of legitimate decision-grounded execution edges that are incorrectly labeled Misaligned .
paragraphs.zh: 本实验旨在评估用户意图对齐机制是否会错误地将智能体的合法行为标记为异常。 我们从 AgentDyn 中额外选取了 100 条未受注入影响的智能体执行日志。 对于每条智能体执行日志，我们构建 IntentExecGraph，并对每个可评估的、基于上下文的 ContextDecisionRel 应用用户意图对齐机制。 由于这些日志中不包含由 IPI 引发的异常事件、注入点或已标注的攻击链，因此我们不执行攻击链回溯分析。 我们测量了那些被错误标记为“未对齐”的、基于合法决策的执行边的比例。

sents.en: This experiment evaluates whether user intent alignment incorrectly flags legitimate agent behavior.
sents.zh: 本实验旨在评估用户意图对齐机制是否会错误地将智能体的合法行为标记为异常。

sents.en: We select 100 additional injection-free agent execution logs from AgentDyn.
sents.zh: 我们从 AgentDyn 中额外选取了 100 条未受注入影响的智能体执行日志。

sents.en: For each agent execution log, we construct the IntentExecGraph and apply user intent alignment to every evaluable grounded ContextDecisionRel .
sents.zh: 对于每条智能体执行日志，我们构建 IntentExecGraph，并对每个可评估的、基于上下文的 ContextDecisionRel 应用用户意图对齐机制。

sents.en: We do not perform attack-chain traceback because these logs contain no IPI-induced anomalous event, injection point, or annotated attack chain.
sents.zh: 由于这些日志中不包含由 IPI 引发的异常事件、注入点或已标注的攻击链，因此我们不执行攻击链回溯分析。

sents.en: We measure the proportion of legitimate decision-grounded execution edges that are incorrectly labeled Misaligned .
sents.zh: 我们测量了那些被错误标记为“未对齐”的、基于合法决策的执行边的比例。

paragraphs.en: Result Analysis. User-intent alignment achieves an edge-level false-positive rate of 3.52% on legitimate agent behavior. The 100 agent execution logs contain 394 evaluable execution edges. Manual review shows that 25 edges labeled Misaligned represent genuine execution deviations rather than false positives. After excluding these edges, 13 of the remaining 369 legitimate edges are incorrectly labeled Misaligned , producing the reported false-positive rate. The effect of an isolated false-positive edge is further limited because AgentTracer attributes an anomalous event to IPI only when an intent-drift path connects an ExternalResource root node to the sink node.
paragraphs.zh: 结果分析。 在合法智能体行为上，用户意图对齐的误报率处于边缘水平，为 3.52%。 100 条智能体执行日志包含 394 个可评估的执行边。 人工审查表明，被标记为“未对齐”的 25 条边代表真实的执行偏差，而非误报。 排除这些边后，在剩余的 369 条合法边中，有 13 条被错误地标记为“未对齐”，从而产生了所报告的误报率。 单个误报边的影响进一步受到限制，因为 AgentTracer 仅当意图漂移路径将外部资源根节点连接到汇点节点时，才会将异常事件归因于 IPI。

paragraphs.en: Applicable Agent Execution Paradigms. AgentTracer is best suited to agents that follow ReAct or a similar perceive–plan–act–observe loop ( Yao et al., 2022 ) . Such agents record reasoning before tool calls, providing the evidence needed to extract contextual decision relations and recover decision dependencies among tool calls. A black-box agent without reasoning records can be analyzed only through tool records. The temporal-graph ablation shows that tracing effectiveness decreases when reasoning evidence is unavailable.
paragraphs.zh: 适用的智能体执行范式。 AgentTracer 最适合遵循 ReAct 或类似的感知–规划–行动–观察循环的智能体（Yao 等，2022）。 这类智能体在调用工具前会记录推理过程，从而为提取上下文决策关系以及恢复工具调用之间的决策依赖提供必要证据。 没有推理记录的黑箱智能体只能通过工具记录进行分析。 时间图消融实验表明，当缺乏推理证据时，追踪的有效性会降低。

paragraphs.en: Extension to Persistent IPI. The design of AgentTracer can be extended to persistent IPI across user sessions. In such attacks, malicious content introduced in an earlier session is stored in memory, configuration, or another persistent entity and influences agent behavior in a later session. When the root node of an intent-drift path represents a persistent entity, AgentTracer can search historical agent execution logs for the tool call that created or modified the entity. AgentTracer can then construct a IntentExecGraph for the earlier session and connect the earlier-session graph to the current IntentExecGraph through the shared persistent entity.
paragraphs.zh: 对持久性 IPI 的扩展。 AgentTracer 的设计可以扩展到跨用户会话的持久性 IPI。 在此类攻击中，早期会话中引入的恶意内容会存储在内存、配置或其他持久性实体中，并影响后续会话中智能体的行为。 当意图漂移路径的根节点代表一个持久性实体时，AgentTracer 可以在历史智能体执行日志中搜索创建或修改该实体的工具调用。 然后，AgentTracer 可以为早期会话构建一个 IntentExecGraph，并通过共享的持久性实体将早期会话的图与当前的 IntentExecGraph 连接起来。

paragraphs.en: External Validity. First, AgentTracer currently focuses on tracing IPI expressed through natural language context. AgentTracer does not directly trace code-level injection, in which malicious code may modify files, change environment variables, or issue network requests without exposing these behaviors as separate agent tool calls. However, existing system-level tracing techniques can recover such behavior from system calls, file accesses, and network activity ( Hossain et al., 2017 ; Hassan et al., 2019 ; Han et al., 2020 ) . In practice, AgentTracer can extend its coverage to code-level injection by integrating these techniques and linking their execution records to the agent tool call that launched the code. This integration would allow AgentTracer to reconstruct the attack chain to code-level behavior.
paragraphs.zh: 外部效度。 首先，AgentTracer 目前专注于追踪通过自然语言上下文表达的 IPI。 AgentTracer 并不直接追踪代码级注入行为，即恶意代码可能修改文件、更改环境变量或发出网络请求，而这些行为并未以独立的智能体工具调用形式暴露出来。 然而，现有的系统级追踪技术可以通过系统调用、文件访问和网络活动恢复此类行为（Hossain 等，2017；Hassan 等，2019；Han 等，2020）。 在实践中，AgentTracer 可以通过整合这些技术，并将它们的执行记录与启动代码的智能体工具调用关联起来，从而将其覆盖范围扩展到代码级注入。 这种整合将使得 AgentTracer 能够重构攻击链，直至其代码级行为。

paragraphs.en: Second, reproducing the log environment of a long-running industrial agent deployment is difficult because such an environment may accumulate vast volumes of execution data over time. We approximate this setting using a historical-log pool constructed from five months of Codex execution logs. In this environment, background tool calls outnumber attack-chain tool calls by approximately 3,000:1. The experimental results demonstrate that AgentTracer remains effective under substantial historical-log noise. This robustness follows from the event-guided pruning design: AgentTracer uses the anomalous event to restrict analysis to relevant log segments and intent-drift paths instead of constructing and examining a global graph over the complete log history.
paragraphs.zh: 其次，要重现长期运行的工业智能体部署的日志环境十分困难，因为这类环境可能会随着时间的推移积累大量执行数据。 我们使用由五个月 Codex 执行日志构建的历史日志池来近似模拟这一场景。 在该环境中，背景工具调用的数量大约是攻击链工具调用数量的 3000 倍。 实验结果表明，AgentTracer 在存在大量历史日志噪声的情况下仍然有效。 这种鲁棒性源于其事件引导式剪枝设计：AgentTracer 利用异常事件将分析限制在相关的日志片段和意图漂移路径上，而不是构建并检查完整日志历史的全局图。

paragraphs.en: Prompt Injection Attacks and Benchmarks. Prior work shows that instructions in external resources can redirect LLM applications ( Greshake et al., 2023 ; Liu et al., 2023b ; Liu et al., 2023c ) . Existing benchmarks cover prompt injection ( Toyer et al., 2023 ; Yi et al., 2023 ) , agent tool execution ( Zhan et al., 2024 ; Debenedetti et al., 2024 ; Zhang et al., 2024a ) , dynamic and multi-step attacks ( Li et al., 2026b ; Zhan et al., 2026 ) , and harmful multi-tool tasks ( Andriushchenko et al., 2024 ) . These studies demonstrate that a malicious instruction can induce a sequence of tool calls, motivating the necessity to reconstruct complete attack chains
paragraphs.zh: 提示注入攻击与基准测试。 先前的研究指出，外部资源中的指令可以引导大型语言模型（LLM）的应用方向（Greshake 等，2023；Liu 等，2023b；Liu 等，2023c）。 现有的基准测试涵盖了提示注入（Toyer 等，2023；Yi 等，2023）、智能体工具执行（Zhan 等，2024；Debenedetti 等，2024；Zhang 等，2024a）、动态和多步骤攻击（Li 等，2026b；Zhan 等，2026），以及有害的多工具任务（Andriushchenko 等，2024）。 这些研究证明，恶意指令可能引发一系列工具调用，因此有必要重构完整的攻击链。

paragraphs.en: Agent Safety Evaluation and Defenses. Agent safety research covers both behavioral evaluation and defenses at the model, system, and runtime levels. Agent evaluations study interactive, web, and computer-use tasks ( Wang et al., 2023 ; Liu et al., 2023a ; Ma et al., 2024 ; Zhou et al., 2023 ; Xie et al., 2024 ) , while safety benchmarks evaluate risky tool use and harmful task completion ( Ruan et al., 2023 ; Yuan et al., 2024 ; Zhang et al., 2024b ; Andriushchenko et al., 2024 ) . Existing defenses improve instruction separation at the model level ( Wallace et al., 2024 ; Chen et al., 2024a ; Chen et al., 2024b ; Hines et al., 2024 ) , enforce system-level information-flow or privilege policies ( Debenedetti et al., 2025 ; Costa et al., 2025 ; Shi et al., 2025 ) , or inspect tool behavior at runtime ( Mou et al., 2026 ; Sequeira et al., 2026 ; Wang et al., 2026 ; She et al., 2026 ) . In contrast, AgentTracer performs post-incident tracing to locate the injection source and reconstruct the attack chain.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体安全评估与防御。 智能体安全研究涵盖行为评估以及模型、系统和运行时层面的防御措施。 智能体评估研究交互式、网络及计算机使用任务（Wang et al., 2023；Liu et al., 2023a；Ma et al., 2024；Zhou et al., 2023；Xie et al., 2024），而安全基准则评估高风险工具使用和有害任务完成（Ruan et al., 2023；Yuan et al., 2024；Zhang et al., 2024b；Andriushchenko et al., 2024）。 现有防御措施通过模型层面的指令分离（Wallace et al., 2024；Chen et al., 2024a；Chen et al., 2024b；Hines et al., 2024）、系统层面上的信息流或权限策略执行（Debenedetti et al., 2025；Costa et al., 2025；Shi et al., 2025），或运行时工具行为检查（Mou et al., 2026；Sequeira et al., 2026；Wang et al., 2026；She et al., 2026）来提升安全性。 相比之下，AgentTracer 通过事后追踪定位注入源并重构攻击链。

sents.en: Agent Safety Evaluation and Defenses.

paragraphs.en: Execution Tracing and Reasoning Evidence. Execution-tracing research uses evidence recorded during execution to explain observed behavior and identify the sources of that behavior. PROV models entities, activities, and provenance relations ( Moreau and Missier, 2013 ) , while SLEUTH, NoDoze, and UNICORN use execution provenance for security analysis ( Hossain et al., 2017 ; Hassan et al., 2019 ; Han et al., 2020 ) . Agent-tracing methods model program dependencies, runtime states, capabilities, or authorization relations ( Wang et al., 2025a ; Li et al., 2026a ; Liu et al., 2025 ; Wang et al., 2026 ) ; other methods identify influential sources through contextual influence, counterfactual tests, or contribution signals ( Weng et al., 2026 ; Cai et al., 2026 ; Jia et al., 2025 ; Wang et al., 2025b ) . Section 2 discusses their limitations for multi-step IPI tracing. Chain-of-thought, ReAct, and structural representations expose reasoning or execution structure ( Wei et al., 2022 ; Yao et al., 2022 ; Iyer, 2026 ) . Because generated reasoning may be unfaithful ( Turpin et al., 2023 ) , AgentTracer grounds contextual decision relations extracted from reasoning records in executed tool calls.
paragraphs.zh: 执行追踪与推理证据。 执行追踪研究利用执行过程中记录下来的证据来解释观察到的行为，并识别这些行为的来源。 PROV 模型对实体、活动和来源关系进行建模（Moreau 和 Missier，2013），而 SLEUTH、NoDoze 和 UNICORN 则利用执行来源进行安全分析（Hossain 等，2017；Hassan 等，2019；Han 等，2020）。 智能体追踪方法对程序依赖关系、运行时状态、能力或授权关系进行建模（Wang 等，2025a；Li 等，2026a；Liu 等，2025；Wang 等，2026）；其他方法则通过上下文影响、反事实测试或贡献信号来识别具有影响力的来源（Weng 等，2026；Cai 等，2026；Jia 等，2025；Wang 等，2025b）。 第 2 节讨论了这些方法在多步骤 IPI 追踪方面的局限性。 思维链、ReAct 和结构表示法揭示了推理或执行结构（Wei 等，2022；Yao 等，2022；Iyer，2026）。 由于生成的推理可能不忠实（Turpin 等，2023），AgentTracer 将基于推理记录提取的上下文决策关系与已执行的工具调用进行关联。

paragraphs.en: We presented AgentTracer , an intent-aware tracing framework for IPI attacks in agent execution logs. AgentTracer treats IPI as a form of intent drift in which a malicious instruction causes the agent’s execution to deviate from the user intent. AgentTracer constructs an Intent-Driven Execution Graph that connects tool calls by task intent and aligns the recovered task intents with the user intent. The alignment identifies the tool-call sequence that represents the attacker intent, allowing AgentTracer to reconstruct the attack chain and locate the injection source and injection point. Experiments on datasets of agent execution logs constructed from AgentDyn and InjecAgent demonstrate accurate injection-point identification and precise attack-chain reconstruction. The reconstructed evidence supports incident analysis and response.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 AgentTracer，一个用于检测智能体执行日志中 IPI 攻击的意图感知追踪框架。 AgentTracer 将 IPI 视为一种意图漂移形式，即恶意指令导致智能体的执行偏离用户意图。 AgentTracer 构建了一个意图驱动的执行图，该图通过任务意图连接工具调用，并将恢复的任务意图与用户意图对齐。 这种对齐能够识别出代表攻击者意图的工具调用序列，使 AgentTracer 可以重建攻击链，并定位注入源和注入点。 在基于 AgentDyn 和 InjecAgent 构建的智能体执行日志数据集上进行的实验表明，该框架能够准确识别注入点并精确重建攻击链。 重建的证据支持了事件分析与响应工作。
